1) Preference on 90 vs 120 minutes? If you expect procurement/contract talk + a security deep-dive, 120 gives breathing room. 90 is usually fine if questions are narrow.
2) Who will own the security Q&A on your side (name + title) so Mina can align the content?

Proposed times (we'll hold tentative calendar alternatives once you confirm):
- Option 1 (preferred): Jul 12, 10:00–12:00 PT (120m)
- Option 2: Jul 11, 09:30–11:00 PT (90m)
- Option 3: Jul 14, 08:00–10:00 PT (120m) — earlier slot if travel windows require it

I'll attach the short security artifact pack (SOC2 overview, encryption at rest notes) and a revised agenda that includes breakouts for procurement and platform questions.

--Sean
